summary.zh: 比亚迪、蔚来等车企正加速设计和使用更多本土开发的 AI 功能芯片。

title.zh: Claude Science：科学家的 AI 工作台
title.en: Claude Science, an AI Workbench for Scientists (4 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Science，集成多种科学工具，支持 3D 蛋白质结构、基因组浏览器轨迹和化学结构的本地渲染。
summary.en: Anthropic has announced Claude Science, an AI workbench app available in beta for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users on macOS and Linux. The workbench integrates fragmented scientific tools into a single environment, natively rendering 3D protein structures, genome browser tracks, and chemical structures.

title.zh: Google 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite 和 Gemini Omni Flash
title.en: Nano Banana 2 Lite (6 minute read)

summary.zh: Nano Banana 2 Lite 是 Google 最快、最具成本效益的 Gemini 图像生成模型，同时推出的 Gemini Omni Flash 支持视频生成和对话式编辑。
summary.en: Google released Nano Banana 2 Lite, its fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini Image model, alongside Gemini Omni Flash for video generation and conversational editing. The models are available through AI Studio, the Gemini API, and Google's enterprise and consumer products.

title.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Sonnet 5 模型
title.en: Claude Sonnet 5 (4 minute read)

summary.zh: Claude Sonnet 5 提供更强的规划、工具使用、编码和知识工作能力，性能接近 Opus 4.8。
summary.en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Sonnet 5, a lower-cost Sonnet model with stronger agentic performance in planning, tool use, coding, and knowledge work. Its capabilities were described as approaching Opus 4.8 while improving substantially over Sonnet 4.6.

title.zh: 为什么专业化是不可避免的
title.en: Why Specialization Is Inevitable (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 文章探讨了领域专用 AI 模型为何在资源有限的情况下优于通用模型的原因。
summary.en: Domain-specialized AI models consistently outperform generalized ones because finite resources require concentrated capacity. This pattern aligns across optimization mathematics, biological evolution, market competition, and machine learning, proving that universal generality is structurally inefficient under resource constraints.

title.zh: 深入了解 Thinking Machines 的交互模型
title.en: Inside Thinking Machines' Interaction Models (17 minute read)

summary.zh: Thinking Machines 专注于人机协作的 AI 研究，计划推出支持持续交互的模型研究预览。
summary.en: Thinking Machines is an AI research lab focused on human-AI collaboration. It believes that real work benefits from continuous collaboration, where the human clarifies, redirects, and gives feedback as a model goes along. This requires an interface that supports that instead of treating the human as someone who hands off a task and walks away. Thinking Machines' interaction models make interactivity a part of the model itself. The company plans to open a limited research preview in the coming months, with a wider release later this year.

title.zh: 美团发布LongCat-2.0：1.6万亿参数模型
title.en: Meituan launches LongCat-2.0 1.6T parameter model on APIs (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型专为代理编码、多步骤工作流和长上下文处理设计，是OpenRouter上热门模型“Owl Alpha”的引擎。
summary.en: Meituan has officially launched LongCat-2.0, a massive 1.6 trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model tailored specifically for agentic coding, multi-step workflows, and long-context processing. Notably, the model was unmasked as the engine behind "Owl Alpha," a highly popular stealth model on OpenRouter that recently ranked in the top three by global daily volume.

title.zh: GeneBench-Pro：评估AI代理在科学判断中的表现
title.en: GeneBench-Pro: Scientific Judgment in AI Agents (9 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI推出的基准测试，评估AI在基因组学和定量生物学等研究任务中的表现。
summary.en: OpenAI's GeneBench-Pro is a benchmark that evaluates how AI agents handle ambiguity, revise assumptions, and choose analysis paths in computational biology. It focuses on research-level tasks across genomics, quantitative biology, and translational medicine.

title.zh: Miles：大规模LLM强化学习后训练的PyTorch框架
title.en: Miles: A PyTorch-Native Stack for Large-Scale LLM RL Post-Training (14 minute read)

summary.zh: Miles简化了大规模LLM强化学习后训练的构建、复现和操作，同时保持核心训练器的可定制性。
summary.en: Miles is a framework for large-scale LLM RL post-training. It makes frontier-scale LLM RL easier to build, reproduce, and operate. RL post-training has become a distributed systems problem as models have become larger and run across more distributed and specialized hardware. Miles makes large-scale LLM RL training more composable, reproducible, and easier to scale while keeping the core trainer small enough for researchers and infrastructure teams to customize.

title.zh: OpenAI研究：LLM解决数学前沿问题的能力
title.en: Recent OpenAI research has demonstrated the ability of LLMs to solve frontier problems in mathematics (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 研究人员设计了一个证明-验证工作流，使用GPT-5.5 Pro和Claude Opus 4.7解决数学前沿问题，取得了强劲成果。
summary.en: Researchers set out to find out how good frontier LLMs are at doing frontier theory research. They designed a prover-verifier workflow that used GPT-5.5 Pro as the solver and Claude Opus 4.7 as the verifier. This workflow was stress-tested on open problems from areas with very different levels of familiarity. The results were surprisingly strong and the system resolved a list of open questions.

title.zh: Anthropic启动AI药物研发计划，进军医疗领域
title.en: Anthropic launches AI drug discovery program, joining tech giants in betting on healthcare (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic将专注于开发AI工具，用于发现传统制药公司不关注的被忽视疾病的治疗方法。
summary.en: Anthropic is starting an internal drug discovery program to develop AI tools designed for drugmakers. The company will focus on discovering treatments for neglected diseases that traditional biopharmaceutical companies wouldn't consider attractive targets. It is unclear what Anthropic will do if it finds any promising drug candidates.

summary.zh: 该论坛将分析AI能力与风险，并向盟友提供AI模型。

summary.zh: 融资轮可能扩展至30亿美元。

title.en: CarbonSix, which is developing AI automation and robotic intelligence tech for manufacturing, raised a $40M Series A co-led by DSC Investment and LB Investment

title.en: SoftBank and its telecom unit launch SB Neo to offer AI chips and cloud services to big companies, aiming to provide 10GW of capacity in the US by around 2030

summary.zh: 目标到2030年在美国提供10GW容量。

title.zh: 2026年上半年全球风投融资达5100亿美元，OpenAI和Anthropic占43%
title.en: Global VC funding hit a record $510B in H1 2026, with OpenAI and Anthropic accounting for $217B, or 43% of the total; in Q2, VCs put $205B into 5,000+ startups

summary.zh: 第二季度，风投向5000多家初创公司投资了2050亿美元。

summary.zh: 印度IT公司加速并购，以应对AI驱动的增长变革。

title.zh: Meta计划推出云业务，向外部开发者出售AI计算能力
title.en: Meta Is Planning a Cloud Business to Sell AI Computing Power (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 此举旨在通过数据中心和芯片投资开辟新收入来源，挑战AWS、Azure和Google Cloud。
summary.en: Meta Platforms is developing an internal cloud infrastructure initiative to sell access to its surplus AI computing power and hosted models to external developers. This strategic pivot aims to generate a new revenue stream from the company's massive multi-billion-dollar investments in data centers and chips, directly challenging dominant hyperscalers like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

title.zh: Continual Harness：提升ARC-AGI-3基准测试中智能体的自我改进能力
title.en: Continual Harness: An Efficient Self-Improving Agent on ARC-AGI-3 (3 minute read)

summary.en: The ARC-AGI-3 benchmark tests agents' ability to form and update an internal world model through ongoing learning. Continual Harness aims to efficiently enhance agents' self-improvement capabilities on this challenging IQ test.

title.zh: Autoresearch：基于反馈循环的自我改进智能体
title.en: Autoresearch: The feedback loop behind self-improving agents (11 minute read)

summary.zh: 探讨了从智能体工具到反馈循环的转变，以及开源Pi框架的作用。
summary.en: Autoresearch involves building an 'outer loop' where agents help maintain and improve the primary system using feedback signals, evals, and human input to make progress over time. One of the startups building infrastructure for these self-improving systems is Introspection. This post features an interview with Introspection's co-founder and CEO, Roland Gavrilescu. The discussion covers the shift from agent harnesses to feedback loops, the role of the open-source Pi framework, and why autonomous software factories must first learn from humans.

title.zh: PorTAL：为LLM设计的便携任务适配器
title.en: PorTAL: Portable Task Adapters for LLMs (3 minute read)

summary.zh: PorTAL通过解耦任务微调与基础模型权重，降低了模型更新的财务和工程成本。
summary.en: PorTAL is an innovative architecture designed to decouple task fine-tuning from specific base model weights. As the accelerating cadence of foundation model releases creates a compounding financial and engineering burden to re-tune capabilities from scratch, PorTAL offers a way to pay for task adaptation once and amortize it across all future models.

title.zh: ZCode现已支持macOS、Windows和Linux
title.en: ZCode (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 结合AI智能体与现有工具，提升开发者的编码效率。
summary.en: ZCode is now available on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It combines the best AI agents with existing tools so developers can plan, code, review, and deploy without friction. GLM-5.2 is tuned for ZCode, making agentic coding faster and steadier. GLM Coding Plan subscribers now have 1.5x usage quota in ZCode.

title.zh: 在金融任务中学习复制专家判断
title.en: Learning to Replicate Expert Judgment in Financial Tasks (14 minute read)

summary.zh: 定制模型在高质量专有数据集上微调后表现优于前沿模型，且成本更低。
summary.en: Frontier models struggle with relatively simple financial tasks. Custom models fine-tuned on high-quality proprietary datasets labeled by expert investors perform better. They are also substantially cheaper. Models of the future will probably feature differentiated intelligence - organizations will have custom models tuned to their specific needs that outperform frontier models.

title.zh: AI 对就业影响的新视角：企业级 AI 投资与劳动力调整
title.en: A New Look at AI's Impact on Jobs: Firm-Level AI Spending and Workforce Adjustment (4 minute read)

summary.zh: Ramp 和 Revelio Labs 的联合研究分析了企业级生成式 AI 投资与美国 21,000 多家公司就业结果之间的关系。研究显示，高强度 AI 投资的公司在采用后两年内整体员工人数增长了 10.2%，入门级职位增长了 12%。
summary.en: A joint study by Ramp and Revelio Labs analyzed the relationship between firm-level generative AI investments and employment outcomes across over 21,000 companies in the US. The research reveals that companies with high-intensity AI spending grew their overall headcount by 10.2 percent and entry-level positions by 12 percent over the two years following adoption.

title.zh: 产品形态是护城河
title.en: Product Shape is the Moat (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 应用层 AI 公司无法通过简单的技术调整（如微调或模型路由）对模型提供商建立可持续的护城河。
summary.en: Application layer AI companies cannot build sustainable moats against model providers through simple technical adjustments like fine tuning or model routing.

title.zh: OpenAI 提议向特朗普政府提供 5% 股权以缓解华盛顿压力

summary.zh: 该提议是更大安排的一部分，根据该安排，美国政府将通过主权财富基金工具持有每家领先美国 AI 开发商 5% 的股份。
summary.en: The proposal is part of a larger arrangement under which the US government would hold 5% of each of the leading US AI developers through a sovereign wealth fund vehicle.

title.zh: Meta的Watermelon模型性能接近GPT-5.5
title.en: Sources: Alexandr Wang said Meta's model currently in training, codenamed Watermelon, matches GPT-5.5 and uses an “order of magnitude more compute than Avocado”

summary.zh: Alexandr Wang透露，Meta正在训练的代号为Watermelon的模型性能接近GPT-5.5，并使用了比Avocado多一个数量级的计算资源。

summary.zh: Meta可能将计算资源用于自有模型、广告扩展、类似SpaceX的云服务交易以及托管第三方模型，并可能接近与Anthropic达成合作。

title.zh: Anthropic探索与三星的芯片合作
title.en: Anthropic Exploring a Samsung Chip Partnership (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 据报道，Anthropic正在与三星讨论定制AI芯片的合作，以实现计算堆栈的多样化，同时仍将谷歌、亚马逊和Nvidia的芯片作为其硬件战略的核心。
summary.en: Anthropic reportedly discussed a custom AI chip collaboration with Samsung as it looked to diversify its compute stack. The company said chips from Google, Amazon, and Nvidia remained central to its hardware strategy.

title.zh: Meta的Watermelon模型性能达到GPT-5.5基准
title.en: Meta's Watermelon Matches GPT-5.5 Benchmarks (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Meta的超智能负责人Alexandr Wang表示，公司即将推出的代号为Watermelon的模型在AI基准测试中已赶上OpenAI的GPT-5.5。该模型仍在训练中，使用的计算资源比Muse Spark多一个数量级。
summary.en: Meta's superintelligence chief, Alexandr Wang, says that the company's upcoming model has caught up with OpenAI's GPT-5.5 on closely followed AI benchmarks. Codenamed Watermelon, the model is still in training. The model reportedly uses an order of magnitude more compute than Muse Spark. Meta has not given a timeline for Watermelon.

title.zh: Seed2.0模型卡发布
title.en: Seed2.0 Model Card (72 minute read)

summary.zh: Seed2.0专注于长尾知识、复杂指令执行、推理、视觉理解和现实任务的搜索，采用以用户需求和复杂使用场景为中心的评估驱动方法。
summary.en: Seed2.0 focused on long-tail knowledge, complex instruction following, reasoning, visual understanding, and search for real-world tasks. The model card described an evaluation-driven approach built around user needs and complex usage scenarios.

title.zh: 残差上下文扩散语言模型提升dLLM性能
title.en: Residual Context Diffusion Language Models (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 残差上下文扩散模块通过回收被丢弃的标记表示，将其转化为上下文残差并注入下一步去噪过程，在多个基准测试中以最小的额外计算开销显著提升了dLLM的准确性。
summary.en: State-of-the-art block-wise Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) rely on a remasking mechanism that decodes only the most confident tokens and discards the rest. Recycling computation from the discarded tokens is beneficial, as these tokens retain contextual information useful for subsequent decoding iterations. Residual Context Diffusion is a module that converts these discarded token representations into contextual residuals and injects them back for the next denoising step. It consistently improves frontier dLLMs in terms of accuracy with minimal extra computation overhead across a wide range of benchmarks.

It supports various platforms and offers three quantized checkpoints for resource-efficient deployment. Licensed under OpenMDW-1.1, it enables open model distribution and is available for download on Hugging Face or via API.

title.zh: Devin Security Swarm：高效发现代码漏洞的新架构

summary.zh: Devin Security Swarm通过Agentic MapReduce架构以低成本高精度发现复杂代码库中的安全漏洞，并通过隔离沙箱验证严重漏洞后进行标记。
summary.en: Devin Security Swarm is a cost-effective and accurate way to find security vulnerabilities in complex codebases. It uses a new architecture for whole-codebase reasoning called Agentic MapReduce. Devin maps relevant signals across a repository, fans out focused agents over bounded shards, reduces their findings to one report, then verifies serious vulnerabilities in isolated sandboxes before marking them confirmed. Cognition has published extensive documentation and technical materials about Agentic MapReduce.

It uses a regression model with selected instances from non-agentic benchmarks to predict scores on agentic benchmarks. title.zh: 自我改进的工程方法
title.en: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement (28 minute read)

summary.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is when ultraintelligent machines can design better machines to improve themselves and surpass humans in all intellectual activities. The feedback loop in modern AI involves models improving the training pipeline and deployment system, which enables better successor models with improved performance. A harness is the system surrounding a base model that orchestrates execution and decides how a model thinks and plans, calls tools and acts, perceives and manages context, stores artifacts, and evaluates results. This post looks at the research around harness engineering and how it contributes to RSI.

title.zh: MiniMax M3：稀疏注意力让长时间任务更高效
title.en: MiniMax M3: How Sparse Attention Makes Long-Horizon Agents Practical (11 minute read)

summary.zh: MiniMax 稀疏注意力通过优化模型读取方式，降低长时间任务的计算成本，同时保持质量。
summary.en: Long-horizon tasks are demanding because the context never stops growing. The longer an agent works, the more expensive each step becomes. MiniMax Sparse Attention changes what the model reads at each step, which results in predictable cost at any length and cheap long context with minimal quality cost. It makes long context cheap and fast enough to sit inside iterative systems that need to keep state over time.

title.zh: J 空间：理解大语言模型的新工具
title.en: No Space Like J-Space (54 minute read)

summary.zh: J 空间和 J 镜头是研究大语言模型的新方法，能够追踪模型各层的概念关联，显著提升对模型的理解。
summary.en: The 'J-space' is the area of conscious access where things are available for a model to do what humans could call conscious reasoning. It is named after an interpretability technique called the Jacobian Lens, which computes, for each layer, the average causal effect of changes in the residual stream of a model's eventual outputs, averaged across a wide variety of contexts. This allows researchers to trace what concepts are associated with each layer as the model proceeds through. The J-space and J-lens are remarkably effective tools and mark a major advance in our understanding of LLMs.

summary.en: AI is unlocking valuable datasets from the physical world by combining cheaper sensors, robotics, and multimodal models. New data flywheels around infrastructure, healthcare, and industrial automation could create the next generation of enduring AI businesses.

title.zh: OpenAI收购Northslope，将工程师嵌入企业
title.en: OpenAI buys Northslope to put its engineers inside your business (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过收购应用AI公司Northslope，OpenAI增加了数百名前线部署工程师。
summary.en: The purchase of Northslope, an applied-AI firm, adds hundreds of forward-deployed engineers to OpenAI's ranks.

title.zh: Robostral Navigate：单摄像头AI导航模型
title.en: Robostral Navigate: single-camera AI navigation (5 minute read)

summary.zh: Mistral推出的Robostral Navigate是一款8B参数的AI模型，能够让机器人使用单个RGB摄像头自主导航环境。
summary.en: Mistral's Robostral Navigate is an 8B AI model that enables robots to autonomously navigate environments using a single RGB camera.

title.zh: 苹果起诉OpenAI，指控前苹果员工窃取商业机密
title.en: Apple sues OpenAI, alleging that ex-Apple employees stole “Apple's trade secrets for the benefit of OpenAI”, and says OpenAI never responded to its concerns

summary.zh: 苹果指控前员工为OpenAI窃取商业机密，并表示OpenAI未回应其关切。

title.zh: 欧盟委员会称Facebook和Instagram的“上瘾设计”违反DSA
title.en: In preliminary findings, the EU Commission said Facebook's and Instagram's “addictive design” violates the DSA, telling Meta to make changes or risk hefty fines

summary.zh: 欧盟要求Meta对其平台设计进行修改，否则将面临巨额罚款。

title.zh: 美国商务部放宽对阿联酋的出口管制
title.en: The Department of Commerce loosens export controls to the UAE, letting G42 and US companies like Apple, Meta, and xAI export AI chips to UAE without a license

summary.zh: 允许G42和美国公司向阿联酋出口AI芯片，无需许可证。

title.zh: OpenAI和Google向阿里巴巴、百度和腾讯的子公司出售AI服务
title.en: OpenAI and Google sold AI services to Singapore-based subsidiaries of Alibaba, Baidu, and Tencent, reigniting calls for tighter US regulation of AI models

summary.zh: 此举引发了对美国加强AI模型监管的呼声。

title.zh: 英国将微软、谷歌、亚马逊和甲骨文列为关键金融供应商
title.en: The UK designates Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and Oracle as critical third-party financial sector suppliers, bringing them under direct regulatory oversight

summary.zh: 这些公司将受到直接监管。

title.zh: Meta超级智能实验室的年度发展回顾
title.en: A look at Meta Superintelligence Labs' growth in the past year, including a top-tier RL environment and compute ramp that could catch up to Anthropic and OpenAI

summary.zh: 包括顶级强化学习环境和计算能力的提升，可能赶超Anthropic和OpenAI。

title.zh: 马来西亚总理计划推出自己的AI虚拟形象
title.en: Malaysia Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim plans to debut an agentic AI avatar of himself within days, which is meant to help the public navigate government services

summary.zh: 该虚拟形象旨在帮助公众更好地使用政府服务。

title.zh: CXMT如何通过技术、资金和国家支持挑战顶级存储芯片制造商
title.en: Interviews with employees and insiders reveal how CXMT is amassing tech, funding, and state support to challenge top memory chipmakers and build local suppliers

summary.zh: 内部人士透露CXMT正在构建本地供应链。

title.zh: 分析：五大科技公司在美国数据中心的巨额投资
title.en: Analysis: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle, the top spenders on new US data centers, collectively added ~$350B in debt over the past five years

summary.zh: Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta、微软和甲骨文过去五年共增加了约3500亿美元的债务。

title.zh: Oxylabs获得1.3亿美元投资，估值达36亿美元
title.en: Oxylabs, which develops web data scraping infrastructure, received a $130M investment at a $3.6B valuation from Warburg Pincus, its first outside investment

summary.zh: 这是其首次接受外部投资，由Warburg Pincus领投。

title.zh: Xreal发布299美元A01 Plus AR眼镜，重量仅62克，配备1080p微型OLED屏幕
title.en: Xreal launches $299 A01 Plus AR glasses, weighing just 62 grams and featuring 1080p micro OLED panels with a 120Hz refresh rate and a 50-degree field of view

title.zh: 1X公司推出具备25个自由度的类人机器人Neo
title.en: 1X says its humanoid robot Neo's five-fingered hands have tendon-style actuators that give them 25 degrees of freedom of movement; human hands usually have 27

summary.zh: Neo的五指手部采用肌腱式驱动器，接近人类手部的27个自由度。

title.zh: 中国五年计划首次取消城市就业目标
title.en: China drops a numerical target for urban job creation in its five-year plan, the first such omission since the 1990s, amid volatility fueled by AI displacement

summary.zh: 此举反映了因AI取代就业带来的不确定性。

title.zh: Meta推出Muse Spark 1.1，增强多模态推理与工具使用
title.en: Muse Spark 1.1 (8 minute read)

summary.zh: 同时开放Meta Model API的公开预览，供开发者使用。
summary.en: Meta introduced Muse Spark 1.1 with improved tool use, coding, computer interaction, and multimodal reasoning. The company also opened a public preview of its Meta Model API for developers.

title.zh: OpenAI发布GPT-5.6，推出Sol、Terra和Luna模型
title.en: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition (19 minute read)

summary.zh: Sol在编码、网络安全和科学领域表现卓越，具备多代理并行处理和改进的设计判断能力。
summary.en: OpenAI launched GPT-5.6, featuring models Sol, Terra, and Luna, with Sol leading in intelligence and efficiency for coding, cybersecurity, and science. The models excel with fewer tokens at lower costs, with Sol notably outperforming competitors like Claude Fable 5. Enhanced capabilities include multi-agent parallel processing and improved design judgment, advancing cybersecurity and scientific research while maintaining strong safety measures.

title.zh: GPT-5.6 Sol模型在ARC-AGI-3游戏中表现出色
title.en: GPT-5.6 Series (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Sol是首个在ARC-AGI-3公开游戏中获胜的模型，展现了卓越的环境适应能力。
summary.en: GPT-5.6 Sol is the standout model of the GPT-5.6 family. It is the first model to win an ARC-AGI-3 public game. The model is able to read an unfamiliar scene correctly and in the game's own vocabulary. It won the game on ARC-AGI because it correctly oriented itself in a new environment first.

title.zh: GPT-5.6评测：语言理解与生成能力显著提升
title.en: GPT-5.6 Review (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 在上下文准确性和适应性方面表现优异，对AI驱动行业有重大影响。
summary.en: The review highlights GPT-5.6's significant advancements in language understanding and generation, outperforming its predecessors. It demonstrates improved contextual accuracy and adaptability across various applications. These enhancements could substantially impact AI-driven industries.

title.zh: Windows利用AI提升漏洞管理速度
title.en: Evolving Windows vulnerability management to meet the speed of AI-powered discovery (9 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过MDASH扫描系统和云基础设施，优化漏洞发现与修复流程。
summary.en: Windows leverages AI to enhance vulnerability discovery, reduce fix times, and offer timely security updates. It uses the MDASH scanning system and dedicated cloud infrastructure to streamline identifying and fixing issues. By integrating AI into the security update process and collaborating internally and externally, Windows aims to maintain protection speed without compromising update quality.

title.zh: 灵活视频扩散技术提升推理速度与视频质量
title.en: Flexible Video Diffusion (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过灵活的时间和降噪步骤分块，改进了视频生成的长程稳定性。
summary.en: Flex-Forcing trains video diffusion models to switch between bidirectional and autoregressive generation through flexible temporal and denoising-step chunking. The approach improves inference speed, video quality, and long-range stability across different compute budgets.

title.zh: ChatGPT Work：基于GPT-5.6的智能工作空间
title.en: ChatGPT Work (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 整合团队工具上下文，自动生成文档、表格和演示文稿。
summary.en: ChatGPT Work is a GPT-5.6-powered workspace that gathers context from team tools and acts across files and desktop applications. It was designed to turn fragmented project materials into finished documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.

title.zh: OpenAI在与新闻机构的版权诉讼中可能犯下致命错误
title.en: OpenAI may have made a fatal misstep in copyright fight with news orgs (7 minute read)

summary.zh: 新闻机构指控OpenAI多年来隐瞒侵权证据，可能导致其辩护受阻。隐私工程师透露，OpenAI曾误导法院关于搜索ChatGPT日志的技术能力。
summary.en: News organizations suing OpenAI have accused the AI firm of repeatedly lying for years to conceal evidence of infringement that could hobble its defense. OpenAI privacy engineer Vincent Monaco has revealed that OpenAI misled the court for two years about the cost and burdens of searching ChatGPT logs. OpenAI has pretended from the earliest stages of the case that it did not have the technical ability to search large anonymized samples of ChatGPT logs when it had actually already conducted such searches prior to the start of litigation. The discovery may lead to serious sanctions against OpenAI.

title.zh: Anthropic任命前美联储主席本·伯南克为独立信托成员
title.en: Anthropic appoints former Fed Chair Ben Bernanke to its independent trust (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic任命本·伯南克加入长期利益信托，以应对AI的经济影响。
summary.en: Anthropic appointed former Fed Chair Ben Bernanke to its Long-Term Benefit Trust to help navigate AI's economic impacts.

title.zh: 苹果起诉OpenAI：硬件主管与前上司关系紧张
title.en: Apple's OpenAI lawsuit follows months of simmering tensions and highlights OpenAI's hardware chief Tang Tan's strained relationship with former boss John Ternus

summary.zh: 苹果对OpenAI提起诉讼，揭示了硬件主管唐坦与前上司John Ternus之间的紧张关系。

title.zh: 欧盟计划年底前提议新数字规则保护消费者
title.en: EU Justice Commissioner Michael McGrath says the EC is set to propose new digital rules by year-end aimed at protecting consumers from online spending traps

summary.zh: 欧盟司法专员Michael McGrath表示，欧盟委员会将提出新数字规则，旨在保护消费者免受在线消费陷阱的影响。

title.zh: SK海力士在美上市押注AI热潮打破存储芯片周期
title.en: SK Hynix's historic US stock market listing is a bet that the AI boom is breaking the memory chip industry's decades-long boom-and-bust cycle

summary.zh: SK海力士在美国股市的历史性上市，旨在利用AI热潮打破存储芯片行业长期的周期性波动。

title.zh: 分析显示四分之一长文社交媒体帖子由AI生成
title.en: An analysis of 1M+ social media posts from April 24 to June 30: ~25% of longform posts with 250+ words were fully AI-generated; on LinkedIn, the figure was 41%

summary.zh: 对超过100万条社交媒体帖子的分析显示，约25%的250字以上长文帖子完全由AI生成，其中LinkedIn的比例高达41%。

title.zh: Cursor开发通用AI代理Sand，挑战Claude Cowork
title.en: Sources: Cursor is building a general-purpose AI agent codenamed Sand, aimed at non-developers, that handles emails, texts, and documents to rival Claude Cowork

summary.zh: 消息称Cursor正在开发代号为Sand的通用AI代理，面向非开发者用户，支持处理邮件、文本和文档。

title.zh: 博科圣地利用AI聊天机器人设计武器和策划攻击
title.en: How members of the extremist group Boko Haram are using AI chatbots to design explosives, fix or upgrade weapons, and brainstorm attack ideas

summary.zh: 极端组织博科圣地成员正在利用AI聊天机器人设计爆炸物、修复或升级武器，并策划攻击方案。

title.zh: 近200名经济学家联名警告AI导致的快速就业替代
title.en: Nearly 200 economists, including 15 Nobel laureates and Anthropic's Jack Clark, sign a letter titled We Must Act Now, warning of rapid AI-led job displacement

summary.zh: 包括15位诺贝尔奖得主和Anthropic的Jack Clark在内的经济学家签署了一封题为《我们必须立即行动》的公开信，警告AI可能带来的快速就业替代。

title.zh: Meta计划在路易斯安那数据中心追加400亿美元投资
title.en: Meta says it will spend an extra $40B on its nearly 4,000-acre data center campus in Louisiana, aiming for 5GW+ of compute, pushing its total spend beyond $250B

summary.zh: Meta宣布将在其路易斯安那州占地近4000英亩的数据中心园区追加400亿美元投资，总支出将超过2500亿美元。

title.zh: 苹果发布iOS 27等系统公测版，推出全新Siri AI
title.en: Apple releases the first public betas of iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and tvOS 27, marking the public debut of the new Siri AI

title.zh: 开源AI模型面临美国政策考验，Anthropic主导监管行动
title.en: Open-weight AI models face an existential US policy test; Anthropic is leading a regulatory capture campaign against Chinese models over distillation concerns

summary.zh: 开源AI模型因蒸馏技术问题面临政策挑战，Anthropic正主导一场针对中国模型的监管行动。

title.zh: 丹麦团队利用量子计算加速蛋白质预测AI
title.en: A Denmark-based research team is using quantum computers to accelerate AI for predicting proteins, showing a near-term commercial application for quantum tech

summary.zh: 丹麦研究团队展示了量子计算在蛋白质预测AI中的商业应用潜力。

title.zh: Nvidia汽车负责人吴新洲谈自动驾驶芯片与AI模型
title.en: Q&A with Xinzhou Wu, head of automotive at Nvidia, on Nvidia's chips and AI models for autonomous driving, lidar's usefulness for Level 4 autonomy, and more

summary.zh: 吴新洲讨论了Nvidia在自动驾驶领域的芯片与AI模型，以及激光雷达在L4自动驾驶中的作用。

title.zh: 德国防务科技初创公司Helsing完成18亿美元E轮融资

summary.zh: 总部位于慕尼黑的Helsing以180亿美元估值完成18亿美元融资，德国2026年订单额达4.93亿欧元。

title.zh: 西雅图初创公司Augmodo完成2100万美元融资
title.en: Seattle-based Augmodo, whose AI-powered “Smartbadges” worn by employees track shelf inventory, raised $21M led by TQ Ventures at a $350M valuation

summary.zh: Augmodo开发的AI驱动“智能徽章”可追踪库存，融资由TQ Ventures领投，估值达3.5亿美元。
